question: Kaushik starts from point A and walks 32 m towards East. He turns right, walks 16 m and then turns right again, walks 14 m, reaches point B and stops. Chitra starts walking from point 2 which is 60 m east of point A. She walks 18 m north, turns right, walks 19 m, turns right and walks 65 m, turns right and walks 61 m and stops at point Y. What is the shortest distance between point B and point Y? (All turns are 90 degree turns only.)
solution:
Given:

Kaushik starts from point A and walks 32 m towards East.

He turns right, walks 16 m and then turns right again, walks 14 m, reaches point B and stops.

Chitra starts walking from point 2 which is 60 m east of point A.

She walks 18 m north, turns right, walks 19 m, turns right and walks 65 m, turns right and walks 61 m and stops at point Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c7fbb7793aff1e223fb54a11a5c8ab87f7006117a0cdaea85caac7c673ec0f0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5510a91db95528f9ce418ed193ea31e80fc7db9a38037b4edfdd5a3d5fdf5e8b.png] 

Thus, 31 is the shortest distance between point B and point Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
